# RED RXXM

> A bold, location-aware social platform for creators and connectors. Discover people within 50km, go live, host hangouts, and monetize with the in-app RED BUSKET wallet.

RED RXXM is a mobile-first social hybrid mixing feeds, live streaming, premium groups, and proximity-based meetups. Creators can paywall posts, run subscriptions, and accept payments via PayFast (South Africa).

## Pages

- [Feed](/): Home feed with Following, For You, and Discover tabs.
- [Discover](/discover): Trending creators and content from across the platform.
- [Near Me](/near-me): Find users within 50km, live now, and hangout requests.
- [Groups](/groups): WhatsApp-style premium groups gated by subscription or pass.
- [Create](/create): Publish images, videos, text, or reposts.
- [Messages](/messages): Direct messages with other users.
- [Profile](/profile): Your public profile, posts, and series.
- [RED BUSKET Wallet](/wallet): In-app wallet for deposits, spends, and transfers.
- [Install](/install): Install RED RXXM as a PWA on iOS, Android, or desktop.
- [Sign in](/auth): Authenticate with email or Google.
